sites.name: Deep Bhawan office, Chennai (Deep Bhavan, 5/20, Jaffer Syrang Street, Chennai-600001)

scope.item: Urgent repairs & minor works at Deep Bhawan office, Chennai Directorate

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. Percentage rate contract, two cover system. EMD by DD/FDR of scheduled/nationalised bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, valid three months (clause 1.1 says 90 days) from technical bid opening. Tender fee and EMD exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate; tender fee amount not stated.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category & class with CPWD, State PWD, Railways, MES, BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/Autonomous bodies

Similar works completed in last seven years: three works each >= 40%, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; values updated at 7% p.a.; certificates from officer not below Executive Engineer
Similar works: construction of lighthouse/building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC structure/RCC work, and repairs and civil maintenance of building
Average annual turnover on construction works (CA certified) at least 40% of estimated cost during last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2025
Key technical personnel for supervision and execution

Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III), tender acceptance letter (Annexure II), not-blacklisted affidavit, list of relatives serving in MoPSW/DGLL, Make in India self-certification (Annexure VI)
notes: NIT dated 12.03.2026.
